arxiv-1904-10904.title: Applying machine learning to improve simulations of a chaotic dynamical system using empirical error correction
arxiv-1904-10904.description: Abstract Dynamical weather and climate prediction models underpin many studies of the Earth system and hold the promise of being able to make robust projections of future climate change based on physical laws. However, simulations from these models still show many differences compared with observations.

arxiv-2108-08795.title: Variational formulation for fractional hyperbolic problems in the theory of viscoelasticity
arxiv-2108-08795.creator: Julián Bravo-Castillero, Luis Fernando López Ríos
arxiv-2108-08795.description: Abstract . In this article a theoretical framework for problems involving fractional equations of hyperbolic type arising in the theory of viscoelasticity is presented. Based on the Galerkin method, a variational problem of the fractionary viscoelasticity is studied. An appropriate functional setting is introduced in order to establish the existence, uniqueness and a priori estimates for weak solutions.

arxiv-2303-10940.title: Ab initio calculation of the spectrum of Feshbach resonances in NaLi + Na collisions
arxiv-2303-10940.creator: Tijs Karman, Marcin Gronowski, Michał Tomza, Juliana J. Park, Hyungmok Son, Yu-Kun Lu, Alan O. Jamison, Wolfgang Ketterle
arxiv-2303-10940.description: Abstract We present a combined experimental and theoretical study of the spectrum of magnetically tunable Feshbach resonances in NaLi ( a 3 ​ Σ + ) (a^{3}\Sigma^{+}) + + Na collisions. In the accompanying paper, we observe experimentally 8 and 17 resonances occur between B = 0 B=0 and 1400 1400 G in upper and lower spin-stretched states, respectively.

arxiv-2311-13661.title: BenthIQ: a Transformer-Based Benthic Classification Model for Coral Restoration
arxiv-2311-13661.creator: Rupa Kurinchi-Vendhan, Drew Gray, Elijah Cole
arxiv-2311-13661.description: Abstract Coral reefs are vital for marine biodiversity, coastal protection, and supporting human livelihoods globally. However, they are increasingly threatened by mass bleaching events, pollution, and unsustainable practices with the advent of climate change. Monitoring the health of these ecosystems is crucial for effective restoration and management.

arxiv-2405-12200.title: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
arxiv-2405-12200.creator: Xianpeng Liu, Ce Zheng, Ming Qian, Nan Xue, Chen Chen, Zhebin Zhang, Chen Li, Tianfu Wu
arxiv-2405-12200.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xianpeng Liu, Ce Zheng, Ming Qian, Nan Xue, Chen Chen, Zhebin Zhang, Chen Li, Tianfu Wu. We present Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MvACon), a simple yet effective method for improving 2D-to-3D feature lifting in query-based multi-view 3D (MV3D) object detection.

arxiv-2501-17398.title: Consistent continuum equations and numerical benchmarks for a perturbation-based, variable-coefficient acoustofluidic solver
arxiv-2501-17398.creator: Khemraj Gautam Kshetri, Amneet Pal Singh Bhalla, Nitesh Nama
arxiv-2501-17398.description: Abstract We present a consistent continuum framework and a variable-coefficient acoustofluidic solver to analyze acoustic streaming. A perturbation approach is used to split the compressible Navier-Stokes equations into two sub-systems: a first-order harmonic system and a time-averaged second-order mean system. Prior acoustofluidic numerical studies have typically employed simplifying assumptions regarding the second-order mass balance equation and boundary conditions.

arxiv-2502-09215.title: Architecture for Simulating Behavior Mode Changes in Norm-Aware Autonomous Agents
arxiv-2502-09215.creator: Sean Glaze, Daniela Inclezan
arxiv-2502-09215.description: Abstract This paper presents an architecture for simulating the actions of a norm-aware intelligent agent whose behavior with respect to norm compliance is set, and can later be changed, by a human controller. Updating an agent’s behavior mode from a norm-abiding to a riskier one may be relevant when the agent is involved in time-sensitive rescue operations, for example.

arxiv-2503-22271.title: Efficient Epistemic Uncertainty Estimation in Cerebrovascular Segmentation
arxiv-2503-22271.creator: Omini Rathore, Richard Dominik Paul, Abigail Morrison, Hanno Scharr, Elisabeth Pfaehler
arxiv-2503-22271.description: Abstract Brain vessel segmentation of MR scans is a critical step in the diagnosis of cerebrovascular diseases. Due to the fine vessel structure, manual vessel segmentation is time consuming. Therefore, automatic deep learning (DL) based segmentation techniques are intensively investigated.

arxiv-2602-15918.title: EarthSpatialBench: Benchmarking Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs on Earth Imagery
arxiv-2602-15918.creator: Zelin Xu, Yupu Zhang, Saugat Adhikari, Saiful Islam, Tingsong Xiao, Zibo Liu, Shigang Chen, Da Yan, Zhe Jiang
arxiv-2602-15918.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zelin Xu, Yupu Zhang, Saugat Adhikari, Saiful Islam, Tingsong Xiao, Zibo Liu, Shigang Chen, Da Yan, Zhe Jiang. Benchmarking spatial reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has attracted growing interest in computer vision due to its importance for embodied AI and other agentic systems that require precise interaction with the physical world.

arxiv-2602-18269.title: Higher-order spatial photon interference versus dipole blockade effect
arxiv-2602-18269.creator: Arthur Rotari, Mihai A. Macovei
arxiv-2602-18269.description: Abstract The steady-state quantum dynamics of three dipole-dipole coupled two-level emitters, fixed at the vertices of an equilateral triangle, and interacting via the environmental thermostat is investigated. We have analytically obtained the populations of the involved three-atom cooperative states as well as of the second- and third-order spatial photon correlation functions of the light scattered by the few-qubit sample.

pmc-12534958.title: Inhibitory effects of berberine on Fonsecaea monophora in vitro and in vivo
pmc-12534958.creator: Liya He, Yong Zhu, Xin Mei, Bing Yu, Sha Lu, Dongdong Mo, Ruiqiang Fan, Xinsheng Chen, Liyan Xi, Ting Xie
pmc-12534958.description: BackgroundChromoblastomycosis (CBM) is a chronic and difficult-to-treat infection caused by dematiaceous fungi, primarily affecting the skin and subcutaneous tissues. In Southern China, Fonsecaea monophora is recognized as a predominant pathogen agent of CBM cases. Effective therapeutic strategies remain limited for this mycosis.

pmc-12926478.title: The evolving mpox threat (2022-2024): clade dynamics, immune evasion, and escalating global health challenges
pmc-12926478.creator: Muhammad Irfan Khan, Ahmed A. Saleh, Rahmat Ali, Rifat Ullah Jan, Jie Gu, Ji Dejun
pmc-12926478.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The 2022–2024 global Mpox outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, marks a pivotal shift in the virus’s epidemiology, extending beyond its traditional endemic regions in Africa. This review provides a comprehensive synthesis of the evolving Mpox threat, analyzing the dynamics of MPXV clades (I, Ia/Ib, II, IIa/IIb), with a focus on the enhanced transmissibility of the emergent Clade Ib variant linked to APOBEC3-mediated mutations.

pmc-13072419.title: Whole-Transcriptome Sequencing Integrative Analyses Reveal Expression Profiles and ceRNA Regulatory Network of Huoyan Goose Egg Production
pmc-13072419.creator: Yibing Liu, Kun Wang, Xinxin Zhang, Ning Yu, Wenjing Ma, Yunwei Fan, Hui Zhao
pmc-13072419.description: Simple SummaryThe Huoyan goose is a small-sized local breed endemic to China and is characterized by excellent egg production performance. Egg-laying traits are key production and economic traits in geese, and are regulated by genetics and the environment. In the present study, we investigated the genetic regulation of egg-laying traits in Huoyan geese.

pmc-13282793.title: Variability of the Behavioral Assessment Screening Tool for Mobile Health Using Ecological Momentary Assessment in Chronic Traumatic Brain Injury

pmc-13282793.description: ObjectiveTo describe the variability of self-reported behavioral symptoms over a 2-week period in 44 individuals with chronic traumatic brain injury (TBI) using subscale scores from the Behavioral Assessment Screening Tool for Mobile Health (BASTmHealth) collected in a prior feasibility study.DesignSecondary analysis of data collected from a prospective, high-frequency, in situ, repeated-measures design feasibility study of the BASTmHealth.SettingCommunity.

pmc-13392247.title: Revisiting Zn-specific nucleation via a dimensionless factor to quantify interfacial electrochemistry of aqueous batteries
pmc-13392247.creator: Zeyu Wang, Wanhai Zhou, Gaoyang Li, Zhuo Yang, Zefang Yang, Yuhang Liu, Tengsheng Zhang, Hongrun Jin, Shixiang Ding, Junwei Zhang, Xia Wang, Fanxing Bu, Min Wang, Jingwen Zhao, Zaiwang Zhao, Dongyuan Zhao, Dongliang Chao
pmc-13392247.description: Zn-based aqueous batteries have attracted widespread research attention, while the lack of nucleation theory for electrochemical interactions at the Zn-water interface constrains efforts to suppress the thermodynamically spontaneous hydrogen evolution reaction and dendrite formation, thereby stalling practical development. Elucidating Zn electrodeposition in aqueous media requires Zn-specific nucleation theory and a descriptor to regulate interfacial electrochemistry.
